body: VACUUM U4: the Admiral's decision on one outward contact. U4 has closed its source pass: 15 slots, 16 reference bases, 58 properties, every pin verified, and X agrees. But there is NO admissible working-material Y (the wall's compression, modulus and matched density), so no map point can be verified. The strongest captured reference is Specialty Materials' Hy-Bor 104HP/T800/G83 data sheet (updated 2025-10-28). It gives representative 0-degree values for a boron/carbon hybrid, not a qualified wall, and it disagrees with itself: the description names a 250F cure, the cure row says 290F. It also leaves the coupon layup, conditioning and density pairing unstated. Sciences has drafted a clarification to the maker's technical support. It asks which cure applies, the coupon schedule and test basis, whether the density matches the coupons, the boron/carbon split, any multidirectional data, and whether the values are design allowables. It asks for no purchase, no tests and no proprietary data. The draft is UNSENT, with no address and no signature; the full text is in the attached note. CHOICES: (A) he sends it himself, or names a sender and channel for Operations to verify; any reply is archived and verified independently before it touches Y. (B) It is not sent and the working-Y hold stands. DEFAULT if he says nothing: B. I recommend A, because it is the only cheap route to a matched basis. Separately, the 48 h stall notice (10-19 00:14:57) will still find no verified point.
